_comment: C0-17 正文英译 · udio（2026-10-26）。无附加小节。正文「相关条目」3 行带 .md 链接（suno/minimax-audio/runway），related 写 3 条（frontmatter related 是 [suno, elevenlabs, runway]，键按正文链接行对齐=3——minimax-audio 行在正文但不在 frontmatter）。sources 5 条对齐 frontmatter。runs 带「实测建议」三条段。

axes.model_access: An in-house model line (v1/v1.5/v1.5 Allegro, named as current in the official FAQ); the new platform will train new models on licensed and authorised music (UMG announcement). Official pages list no open-weight line, so models are tied to the platform (2026-11-21).
axes.runtime: Web (udio.com), with generation in the vendor cloud; the official Guide describes a prompt→Create web flow, and paid tiers can generate 2/4/10 songs at once. The Discord beta is community history, while the current product surface is the web app (2026-11-21).
axes.local_files: Works live in the account cloud; the new platform moves toward a walled garden, with the official announcement stating that AI-generated music cannot be downloaded or distributed outside the platform (UMG announcement). Transition-period downloads follow the current ToS (2026-11-21).
axes.background: A task model: submit → queue in the cloud → land in the account library. The official Guide says the prompt box does not reset after Create, making it easy to queue further generations, and generation does not depend on the local machine being online. Official pages offer no pause, resume or queue-control panel (2026-11-21).
axes.tools: Creation tools include generate, extend, remix, inpainting, Styles and seed (named in the official Guide and FAQ); the new platform direction adds remix/covers and participating-artist voice styles (WMG announcement) (2026-11-21).
axes.context: Task-based, with no conversational memory; style continuity comes from explicit mechanisms such as Styles, remix, extend and seed, which the official Guide lists as editing tools. Cross-session preferences and user profiles are not listed officially (2026-11-21).
axes.permissions: The copyright settlements are central context: UMG settled and signed a licensing deal on 2025-10-29 and WMG settled on 2025-11-19 (official announcements); Merlin/Kobalt follow-ups are reported by trade media. Sony litigation continues. Output rights shift with the transition ToS and new-platform terms, so check the current ToS before commercial use (2026-11-21).
axes.fit: Fit: the creative experience of one of the two big music generators, with a reputation for complex styles, and tracking the licensed-platform transition. Not fit: a download-and-keep commercial pipeline (the walled-garden direction) or deterministic terms during the transition (2026-11-21).

runs: This entry checks the official site, Guide, FAQ and settlement announcements for capability and legal boundaries. Generation quality, queue behaviour and transition-period download rights need account-level and current-ToS checks.
unknowns:
- Launch date and final terms of the new licensed platform: no fixed date is published; follow announcements and ToS updates.
- Boundary of download and distribution rights during the transition: check the current transition ToS text.
- Concurrency and credit details for free/paid tiers: the pricing page gives the tier framework; exact consumption follows the account page.
related: The other half of music generation's two titans: the two companies' lawsuit/settlement lines are independent, and their terms head in different directions.
Also audio generation: MiniMax runs speech/music dual lines, Udio focuses on music.
Audio-visual up/downstream: soundtracks generated by Udio often feed Runway-class video platforms for scored shorts (cross-linked after filing).
